title: The Drawing of Lots
text: A spirit squats at the crossroads, a bag of skin and grins, rattling a cup of bones. One House pays the toll for all, it croons, and the bones will decide which. It has been doing this a long time. It is never wrong, it says, and it is never kind.

options.label: Let the bones choose, and accept whatever they decide.

outcomes.text: The bones fall, and the spirit grins at one House, and that House pays. The grin lingers.

options.label: The richest House offers to pay for all, and spares the others the bones.

outcomes.text: The spirit is impressed, which is rare, and it says so to everyone it meets.

options.label: Refuse the toll. No bag of bones decides your fate.

outcomes.text: The spirit takes its due another way, and it brought friends to collect.
